assessment: Upstream fix changes include/std/bitset, not shared-library runtime behavior. GCC headers/compilers are absent; replacing libstdc++ alone would not repair an already compiled vulnerable instantiation. Node compiler metadata predates affected GCC13+ handling; observed Node bitset stream symbols are narrow output, not wide input. Reviewed locked native/addon source search found no wide/bitset input path: 28 locked source archives plus sharp/addon header materials were searched, and the sole generic-istream hit is a libtiff comment documenting narrow byte I/O. Skia observed bitset symbols use libc++ ABI. This is a supported-flow/source assessment, not proof against all inlined code or a native binary rebuild.
reassess_if: Change compiler/headers, native source/build profile, addons or stream parsers
Introduce wide-stream/std::bitset extraction; compile application/native code using affected GCC headers
required_condition: C++ code compiled from affected libstdc++ headers instantiates wide-character stream extraction into std::bitset
scope: Exact trial images and unmodified supported startup, health, application and maintenance flows; does not cover arbitrary operator execution, custom server/plugin/native code or host/service-image vulnerabilities.

assessment: Node reports features.quic=false, although its embedded OpenSSL still contains QUIC symbols. The shipped JS has no node:quic use. This excludes supported consumers, not the underlying OpenSSL QUIC implementation or the separate edge service.
reassess_if: Enable HTTP3/QUIC or Node experimental QUIC
